description: CKEditor plugin for bidirectional text support, managing text direction and related UI states.

methods.name: onSelectionChange
methods.description: Handles selection change events to update toolbar states and handle mixed direction content.

methods.name: setToolbarStates
methods.description: Sets the state of direction toggle buttons based on current selection.

methods.name: handleMixedDirContent
methods.description: Adds or removes class indicating mixed text direction in content.

methods.name: getElementForDirection
methods.description: Finds the appropriate element to apply direction styles.

methods.name: switchDir
methods.description: Switches the text direction of a given element and updates styles/attributes accordingly.

methods.name: getFullySelected
methods.description: Determines if a range fully encloses an element of interest.

methods.name: bidiCommand
methods.description: Creates a command function to set text direction (ltr or rtl) for selected elements.
